I should probably start this off by saying this entire nightmare was my own fault, and there were a number of things that contributed to this trip being so bad. Pretty much all of them are things that any sane human being would not do, and the consequences of doing them gave me some very valuable lessons about using drugs.

The day started with an all day punk festival, lasting from about 12pm to 8pm. I was drinking cheap beer all day, and was way too tired by 8pm to embark on any tripping activities, but a few years ago I tripped whenever the opportunity arose. I left with a group of friends, not knowing where we were going to stay that night, and we ended up watching a hardcore band play in a small venue for half an hour. We met with another friend, who invited us back to his girlfriend's house and said we should talk to a guy sitting outside to buy some 2C-I.

We ended up getting 2C-E off him as he had run out of 2C-I, and he told us the doses had been eyeballed and weren't weighed out properly. He said they were 20mg but there is no way it was 20mg, I could tell by looking at it. We started to walk to the train station, and I took it while we were waiting for the train at about 9pm. It came on very quick, the train ride only took half an hour, but I was starting to see tracers looking out at the city lights as the train crossed a bridge.

We got off the train and started walking to the house. I should probably describe the group of people I was with at this point. Two of them were my friends who I had known for a long time and I had tripped with them quite a few times, one was an American ex-crack addict who I had never met before, and his girlfriend who I had also not met before. There was another guy there who I can't remember anything about, because he passed out as soon as we got into the house. Then there was the friend who had invited us, who I had only tripped with once before and didn't know as well as my other friends. He has ADHD and was fucking crazy at the time, although he is doing way better now. And then there was his girlfriend, who's house we were staying at. She was a 36 year old woman (my friend was only 19 at the time) and the only thing I knew about her was she had blown a Â£140k inheritance on coke.

We walk inside the house and all of the downstairs lights aren't working. To make things better, she has been out all day and her two dogs have pissed and shat all over the floor, which you could feel as you moved around the house. Everyone decides to go upstairs into her room.

10pm - 1 hour after taking the 2-ce, I'm coming up quite hard, almost like an ecstasy feeling but it seems to have no end, it just keeps going up and up and up to a point where it's starting to feel a little uncomfortable, but not unbearable. I am also starting to get some mild acid-like visuals. My friend needs some air so I go outside with him (one of my good friends, let's call him Ginger). Ginger and I make our way downstairs, through the canine waste, grab some water from the kitchen and go into the back yard. The look on Ginger's face clearly shows that he is experiencing the same come-up discomfort I'm feeling, but worse. I start talking non stop for what feels like 30 mins, but when we go inside and check the time, I realise it has only been 5 minutes. My visuals have now progressed to the point where it appears the entire room is underwater.

From this point onwards, I will not be able to tell you how long it has been since I took the 2-ce, because I experienced time dilation on a scale I didn't know was possible. It is worth pointing out that aside from an uncomfortable body load, I have been enjoying the trip up until this point. Unfortunately, I start to experience "loops" of reality. There is a bong next to my leg which everyone has been using non stop since we arrived at the house, and I feel the bowl touch the side of my leg and burn me. I get up and go for a glass of water, because in my current state of mind, drinking water will help the burning sensation I just felt on my leg. I sit down next to the bong again, and feel it burn my leg again, so I go and get another glass of water. This happened 5-10 times, and I'm pretty sure the bong wasn't even burning me.

Fear gripped me as I realised what was happening. A few months prior to this, a girl we knew had died because she drank way too much water when she took ecstasy. I started to think that this might happen to me. To try and remind myself of the loop I was stuck in, I decided to sit down and whisper-chant "fire, burn, water, swallow" over and over again, instead of telling a friend I needed some fresh air. I was snapped out of this when the friend who invited us to stay (we'll call him Curtis) invited me to go and meet his "stepson" who shared the same name as me. I followed him into the hallway and into one of the other upstairs rooms to see a child about 8 years old laying in his bed playing on an iPad. His girlfriend, unbeknownst to me, had two sons under the age of 10 who were both in the house while their mother was blasting music, smoking weed and tripping on research chemicals with a bunch of people she barely knew. This did not help me.

When we went back into her room, everyone was wearing Donnie Darko style rabbit masks. It was around this time I realised I had probably died at some point during the night. My visuals quickly started to reflect this revelation, and as I sat down, thick black and purple spines formed all over my body and vibrated in sync with the music booming from the corner of the room. I slipped into what I would call temporary psychosis. I started to experience severe visual and audio hallucinations - note I call them hallucinations. This is because I don't think they were all related to the 2-ce, I think something inside me snapped under the stress of what was happening (and one other factor which I will leave out until the end of this report).

I don't know exactly how it happened, because I only remember flashes of events from this point onwards, but my friends told me I started to scream like a banshee and they had to pick me up and put me onto the bed. I remember Ginger and Curtis having a conversation over what they should do about me, because everybody else was tripping pretty hard and they couldn't handle being in the same room as me. My other good friend, who we will call LongHair, suggested that they should just punch me in the head and knock me out. This did not help me, and I started to speak in tongues. At this point, my visuals had progressed to the point where I was seeing horrific things out of the corners of my eyes, and at one point I saw my sister crawling along the walls and ceiling, her head reeling back to keep her eyes fixed on me. Another suggestion my friends had was to tie me up in Curtis' girlfriend's bondage equipment, take me outside and leave me for an ambulance. The American ex-crack addict thankfully said that was a terrible idea and the bondage ropes were packed away.

In the morning, I wasn't sure what had happened. Everyone else was freaked out, and I had faint memories of screaming, but I was too shaken to ask about it. I just wanted to go home, so we left. Unfortunately, we had timed this disaster very badly, as it was marathon day in the city (it is fucking huge and the city is always packed). We had to get on the train, and we ended up waiting in silence as 5-6 trains arrived and departed, each one too full for all of us to fit on. When we finally got on one, we were painfully aware that all of us smelled like dog piss and shit, our pupils were still the size of planets, and I was still acting really oddly.

The effects of this trip lasted for months. Not just psychologically, but in another way. I didn't fully stop tripping for a long time, I would see geometric patterns in floor tiles, shapes in clouds etc.

It was some time after the trip that I realised I had been taking SSRI antidepressants when I took the 2-ce. This mixture is toxic, and the dosage of 2-ce I took might have killed another person. Looking back on it, I now view it as a positive experience, as I'm extremely responsible with drugs now. I also think that if I can make it through until the end of that trip, nothing really seems so daunting.
Probably the most horrific experience I've ever had

Basics for CCW Wannabes: GunsAmerica, 5 Things to Consider Before You Carry Concealed

1. Know the law in your area. Talk to and get to know a local gun friendly lawyer. Do this -before- you have an incident. Even a "good" shoot can have dramatic, life changing consequences.

  2. Select proper GEAR, not just the gun. All of your gear works as a system. Get a good belt. Not a $5 Walmart belt, but a gun belt, such as that made b6 Crossbreed, for example. A cheap belt sags, and lets the gun move around. Expect to spend $40 or more. A good holster that is comfortable, retains the weapon, protects the weapon, covers the trigger, and conceals the weapon. You will need to try various options to see what fits your body. Expect to spend $50 or more. Don't be the guy (gal) that spends $1500 on a gun, and $5 on a holster. When choosing a pistol, only you can decide what meets your needs, but a few things to keep in mind: caliber: minimum .380, 9mm is better. Don't go over .45 for a ccw. .380's are cheap, but usually light weight, and therefore kick more than many 9mm's. Anything bigger than .45 is hard to control and shoot accurately in a ccw sized gun without a -lot- of practice, and if you put that same time/energy into a 9mm-.45 sized gun, you would be better. Weight: ounces=pounds. If the gun is too heavy, you won't carry it. On the other hand, too light for the caliber, and it can be hard to shoot accurately. All guns are a compromise between weight, power, capacity, reliability, and accuracy. Try as many guns as you can before you buy. Don't rely on one person's advice.

  3. Practice. Practice. Practice.

  4. You may need to make adjustments to your clothing. Multiple layers are your friend.

  5. Practice some more. If your weapon can do so, dry fire daily. You would be surprised at the difference this can make.
